subject: Production impact: Northbridge throughput & accuracy deterioration after model v2.3-q rollout
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@northbridgefin.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@northbridgefin.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Sudden latency and hallucination uptick in production after 'v2.3' push

Ben —

We're seeing a large drop in throughput and a big increase in hallucinations after the model upgrade you pushed last night (please see attached sampling). P95 latency is up from ~160ms to ~520ms, error rate on inference calls jumped from 0.4% to ~2.8%, and several of our fraud-scoring workflows are returning gibberish outputs that previously matched expected patterns. This started ~02:30 UTC this morning.

This is impacting live traffic and our SLA. Can you confirm what changed in v2.3 (particularly quant profile) and advise next steps — rollback, routing to a fallback model, or any immediate mitigations? Our SRE will open a support window if needed.

Attaching: small sample of bad outputs and a trace.

—Sam
Director of Engineering, Northbridge Financial

Attachment(s): sample_bad_outputs.json (referenced), trace_20271102.zip (referenced)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@northbridgefin.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Sudden latency and hallucination uptick in production after 'v2.3' push

Sam — thanks for the quick heads up and the samples. I’m escalating immediately. Short answers up front: v2.3 included a new quantization profile (q4_1, narrower weights) and a kernel swap for memory/layout improvements. We rolled the model to 60% of Northbridge traffic at 23:45 PT last night.

Immediate plan we're initiating:
- Opened a high-priority incident with Engineering (cc'd).
- Routing rule: divert 100% of traffic to v2.2 (fallback) within 10 mins if diagnostics point to quant mismatch.
- Requesting perf dumps + stack traces (please see attachments we requested).

Can you confirm whether you want us to start the rollback now if we confirm the quant profile is the root cause? We can also put a temporary per-customer bypass to the older variant while we investigate.

I’ll keep you posted every 30 minutes.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Lead — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 09:10:00 -08:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Northbridge production regression — immediate diagnostics + action items

Team —

Summary: Northbridge reported p95 latency increase to ~520ms, error rate up to ~2.8%, and multiple content-quality regressions post v2.3 rollout (quant profile q4_1 + kernel change). Customer is high priority (payments/fraud). They are threatening to fail the SLA if not mitigated within the window.

What I have from the customer: perf_dump_20271101.csv and error_log_1102.txt (attached). They observed the spike starting ~02:30 UTC.

Asks:
1) Markus: can you confirm whether the q4_1 profile changes KV cache layout or attention kernel ordering? Quick grep of the deploy manifest (deploy_manifest_v2.3.yaml) flagged a switch to contiguous KV packing and a new fused-attn kernel on Ampere v4 nodes. If that causes cache eviction behavior, it could explain both latency and hallucinations.
2) Laura: please open an urgent canary rollback to v2.2 for Northbridge and route 100% of their traffic there if Markus confirms the quant/kernel interaction. Keep a 5% shadow of v2.3 for offline logs.
3) Evelyn/Marissa: please loop in CS and Sales leadership for exec comms; we may need a credit and a written timeline.

Time sensitivity: we need confirmation and a mitigation (rollback or routing change) inside 60 minutes.

Attachment: deploy_manifest_v2.3.yaml (included in customer feed)

—Ben

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Northbridge production regression — immediate diagnostics + action items

Ben / Laura —

Quick findings from an initial look at the dumps:
- The error traces show repeated KV cache misses and unexpected shape casts when using the q4_1 quant table. The fused-attn kernel falls back into a slow path for certain sequence-length distributions we're seeing in Northbridge requests (longer prompt prefixes).
- Throughput drop driven by frequent recompute; p50 idle CPU on the host increased indicating RG memory thrash.
- Quality regressions (hallucinations) line up with misaligned attention slices — outputs contain repeated phrases and token duplication.

Immediate recommendations:
1) Roll back Northbridge to v2.2 (q8_0) as Laura suggested — this will restore previous latency/quality characteristics.
2) Stop further v2.3 rollout until we patch the kernel to gracefully handle the observed seq-len distribution and adjust KV packing for q4_1.
3) Create a dedicated test harness reproducing Northbridge traffic pattern; I'll start a target repro run on a mirrored dataset.

I can push the rollback now if you authorize.

—Markus
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime

Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 12:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Exec summary & ask: Northbridge outage window and remedy (rollback started)

Marissa / Evelyn / Laura —

Quick exec summary for awareness + next steps (for your external communications):
- Impact: Northbridge Financial experienced ~3x p95 latency increase and ~7x error-rate uptick after we rolled model v2.3 (q4_1 + fused-attn kernel). Also observed generation-quality regressions affecting downstream fraud scoring.
- Root-candidate: interaction between q4_1 quant packing and the new fused-attn kernel when serving prompts with long prefixes -> KV cache misalignment and fallback slow-paths.
- Action taken: with Markus' confirmation, we initiated an immediate rollback to v2.2 (q8_0) for Northbridge at 12:30 PT; routing now at 100% v2.2. We left a 5% shadow to capture telemetry.
- Customer comms: Evelyn is queued to send an apology + proposed remediation timeline. We should offer a service credit for the window and a postmortem within 72 hours.
- Next engineering actions: patch kernel to handle seq-len edge cases, add regression test for q4_1 with varied prefix lengths, and add an automated canary failure detector tied to p95 + hallucination-score heuristics.

Ask from leadership: please approve standard remediation credit (suggest 15% of monthly invoice for the impacted window) and authorize a hotfix priority for the kernel patch (sev-high).

I'll draft a customer-facing note once you confirm credit approval.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Lead — Redwood Inference
